title: specgen: apply no_new_privileges config default
body:
## Summary

Apply `[containers].no_new_privileges` when a container request leaves the setting unspecified.

An explicit `--security-opt no-new-privileges=true` or `--security-opt no-new-privileges=false` takes precedence. The default is applied during server-side spec completion, so remote requests use the server's configuration.

## Changes
- Apply the config default during spec completion.
- Document the option and its CLI override.
- Add e2e and system coverage for the configured default and explicit override.

## Tests
- `make localintegration FOCUS_FILE=containers_conf_test.go FOCUS="no_new_privileges default and security-opt override" GINKGO_PARALLEL=n` — passed.
- `hack/bats 030:"podman run no_new_privileges from containers.conf module"` — passed in root and rootless modes.

Fixes: #30046
